cbb.name: Okubabuka kw'omuwogo okw'obuwuka
cbb.shortDescription: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuyinza okwonoona ebikoola n'ebikolo. Butera okubuna mu biseera eby'enkuba n'okusimba ebitooke ebirwadde.
symptoms: Amabala ag'ekikooko ku kikoola, oluusi nga galiko ebbala erya kyenvu
Obubonero obuddugavu oba amazzi ag'amatankane biyinza okulabika ku bikolo
whatToDoNow: Gyawo ebimera ebirwadde ennyo ng'ennimiro ekalidde, era obiteeke wala n'ennimiro.
Tokozesa bikolo oba bikozesebwa okuva ku bimera birwadde ku bimera biramu.
Kozesa ebitooke ebiramu okusimba omulundi oguddako.
prevention: Simbira ku bitooke ebiramu okuva eri omuntu omwesigwa.
Naaza ebikozesebwa ng'ova mu nnimiro emu ogenda mu ndala.
Lekawo ekifo ekimala wakati w'ebimera empewo esobole okuyitamu.
cbb.whenToCall: Buuza omukozi w'ebyobulimi singa ebimera bingi biwotoka, ebikolo biriko obubonero obuddugavu, oba ekizibu kibuna mangu.

cbsd.name: Ekirwadde ky'omuwogo eky'ebbala ery'ekikooko
cbsd.shortDescription: Ekirwadde kya vayirasi ekibuna okuyita mu bisowera ebyeru n'ebitooke ebirwadde. Kiyinza okuleeta obubonero ku bikoola n'amabala ag'ekikooko mu mirandira.
symptoms: Amabala aga kyenvu okumpi n'emisuwa gy'ebikoola
Amabala ag'ekikooko oba ebifo ebikaze mu mirandira
Ekimera ekiyiseeko kiyinza okuba ekimpi oba obuwanvu obutafaanana
whatToDoNow: Tosimba bikolo okuva ku bimera ebiyinza okuba ebirwadde.
Kebera emirandira gy'ebimera ebitonotono singa kisoboka bulungi.
Funa amagezi nga tonnagyawo bimera bingi.
prevention: Simbira ku kika ky'omuwogo ekirungi era ekikkirizibwa mu kitundu kyo.
Gyawo emimera gy'omuwogo egyamera gyokka era weetegereze ebisowera ebyeru.
cbsd.whenToCall: Tuukirira omukozi w'ebyobulimi ng'olabye amabala aga kyenvu ku bikoola oba amabala ag'ekikooko mu mirandira.

cgm.name: Amabala ag'ekibisi ku muwogo
cgm.shortDescription: Ekirwadde kya vayirasi ekiyinza okuleetera ebikoola by'omuwogo okuba n'amabala oba okukula mu ngeri etali ya bulijjo. Ebitooke ebirwadde biyinza okutwala obulwadde mu nnimiro empya.
symptoms: Amabala ag'ekibisi ekitangaala n'ekiddugavu agatali geenkana
Ebikoola biyinza okufuuka ebifunda, ebikyamu oba ebitono
whatToDoNow: Teeka akabonero ku bimera ebiriko obubonero obweyolefu era okebere ebiriraanye.
Tojjamu bikolo ku bimera ebirabika ng'ebirwadde.
Funa amagezi mu kitundu kyo nga tonnagyawo bimera.
prevention: Simbira ku bitooke ebiramu okuva eri omuntu omwesigwa.
Nnimiramu ennimiro obutalekawo bimera bya muwogo ebyamera byokka.
Kebera ebimera ebito buli kiseera olabe enkyukakyuka mu bikoola.
cgm.whenToCall: Buuza omukozi w'ebyobulimi singa amabala galabika ku bimera bingi oba ebikoola ebipya bitandika okukula mu ngeri etali ya bulijjo.

cmd.name: Ekirwadde kya mosaiki mu muwogo
cmd.shortDescription: Ekirwadde kya vayirasi ekibuna okuyita mu bisowera ebyeru n'ebitooke ebirwadde. Kireeta amabala aga kyenvu ku bikoola era kiyinza okukendeeza ku makungula g'emirandira.
symptoms: Amabala aga kyenvu ekitangaala n'ekibisi ku bikoola
Ebikoola biyinza kwezingako, okukyama oba okufuuka ebitono
Ekimera kiyinza okuba ekimpi okusinga emimera emiramu egyakyo
whatToDoNow: Tojjamu bikolo ku bimera ebiriko obubonero bwa mosaiki.
Kebera ennimiro yonna, naddala ebimera ebito.
Funa amagezi mu kitundu kyo nga tonnagyawo bimera mu nnimiro yonna.
prevention: Londa ebitooke ebiramu n'ebika ebisaanira ekitundu kyo.
Buuza omukozi w'ebyobulimi ku ngeri y'okufuga ebisowera n'obulwadde.
cmd.whenToCall: Kuba omukozi w'ebyobulimi essimu singa obubonero bubunye oba ebimera tebyakula bulungi.

healthy.name: Omuwogo ogulabika ng'omulamu
healthy.shortDescription: Ekifaananyi kirabika ng'eky'ebikoola by'omuwogo ebiramu. Ekifaananyi tekisobola kulaga buli kawuka, kizibu kya mirandira oba obulwadde obutandise.
symptoms: Ebikoola ebisinga birina langi n'endabika y'emu
Tewali bubonero bwa bulwadde obweyolefu mu kifaananyi kino
whatToDoNow: Weeyongere okukebera ebikoola n'engeri ekimera gye kikulamu.
Kozesa ebitooke ebiramu era ennimiro yo ogikuume bulungi.
prevention: Simbira ku bitooke ebiramu ebisaanira ekitundu kyo.
Kebera ebimera buli kiseera, n'okuli wansi w'ebikoola.
healthy.whenToCall: Buuza omukozi w'ebyobulimi singa ekimera kiwotoka, tekikula bulungi, oba kirabika ng'ekiriko amabala amapya.
